# Vector Index

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:VectorIndex`](gmeow-VectorIndex.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/VectorIndex>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/graphrag`](../../slices/graphrag.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A built retrieval structure over a corpus's embeddings — the artifact a [`RetrievalEvent`](gmeow-RetrievalEvent.md) queries. Carries its algorithm ([`gmeow:indexAlgorithm`](../properties/gmeow-indexAlgorithm.md)), parameters (verbatim, for reproducibility), and metric; its build provenance rides the EXISTING [`gmeow:wasGeneratedBy`](../properties/gmeow-wasGeneratedBy.md), tying index contents to the corpus state ([`contentDigest`](../properties/gmeow-contentDigest.md)) at build time.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:VectorIndex`](gmeow-VectorIndex.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
